SELECT COUNT(T1."XCL_009") FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1."XCL_012" = T2."XCL_017" WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1."XCL_011") = '1920' AND T2."XCL_019" = 'east Bohemia'
SELECT COUNT(T2."XCL_034") FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1."XCL_001" = T2."XCL_034" WHERE T2."XCL_037" = 24 AND T1."XCL_003" = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
SELECT AVG(T2."XCL_036") FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1."XCL_001" = T2."XCL_034" WHERE T2."XCL_039" IN ('C', 'D') AND T1."XCL_003" = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'

SELECT T3."XCL_014", T2."XCL_017", T2."XCL_018" FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1."XCL_002" = T2."XCL_017" INNER JOIN disp AS T3 ON T1."XCL_001" = T3."XCL_015" WHERE T3."XCL_016" = 'OWNER'

SELECT T1."XCL_014", STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T3."XCL_011") FROM disp AS T1 INNER JOIN card AS T2 ON T2."XCL_006" = T1."XCL_013" INNER JOIN client AS T3 ON T1."XCL_014" = T3."XCL_009" WHERE T2."XCL_007" = 'gold' AND T1."XCL_016" = 'OWNER'
SELECT COUNT(T2."XCL_001") FROM district AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1."XCL_017" = T2."XCL_002" WHERE T1."XCL_019" = 'east Bohemia' AND T2."XCL_003" = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
SELECT COUNT(T1."XCL_001") FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1."XCL_001" = T2."XCL_034" INNER JOIN district AS T3 ON T1."XCL_002" = T3."XCL_017" WHERE T3."XCL_019" = 'Prague'
SELECT DISTINCT IIF(AVG("XCL_029") > AVG("XCL_028"), '1996', '1995') FROM district
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2."XCL_017") FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1."XCL_012" = T2."XCL_017" WHERE T1."XCL_010" = 'F' AND T2."XCL_027" BETWEEN 6000 AND 10000
SELECT COUNT(T1."XCL_009") FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1."XCL_012" = T2."XCL_017" WHERE T1."XCL_010" = 'M' AND T2."XCL_019" = 'north Bohemia' AND T2."XCL_027" > 8000

SELECT T1."XCL_001", (SELECT MAX("XCL_027") - MIN("XCL_027") FROM district) FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1."XCL_002" = T2."XCL_017" INNER JOIN disp AS T3 ON T1."XCL_001" = T3."XCL_015" INNER JOIN client AS T4 ON T3."XCL_014" = T4."XCL_009" WHERE T2."XCL_017" = (SELECT "XCL_012" FROM client WHERE "XCL_010" = 'F' ORDER BY "XCL_011" ASC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY T2."XCL_027" DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T1."XCL_001" FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1."XCL_001" = T2."XCL_015" INNER JOIN client AS T3 ON T2."XCL_014" = T3."XCL_009" INNER JOIN district AS T4 ON T4."XCL_017" = T1."XCL_002" WHERE T2."XCL_014" = (SELECT "XCL_009" FROM client ORDER BY "XCL_011" DESC LIMIT 1) GROUP BY T4."XCL_027", T1."XCL_001"
SELECT COUNT(T1."XCL_001") FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1."XCL_001" = T2."XCL_015" WHERE T2."XCL_016" = 'OWNER' AND T1."XCL_003" = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
SELECT T2."XCL_014" FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1."XCL_001" = T2."XCL_015" WHERE T1."XCL_003" = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' AND T2."XCL_016" = 'DISPONENT'

SELECT T2."XCL_001" FROM loan AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1."XCL_034" = T2."XCL_001" WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1."XCL_035") = '1997' AND T2."XCL_003" = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' ORDER BY T1."XCL_036" LIMIT 1
SELECT T1."XCL_034" FROM loan AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1."XCL_034" = T2."XCL_001" WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2."XCL_004") = '1993' AND T1."XCL_037" > 12 ORDER BY T1."XCL_036" DESC LIMIT 1
